# InnooRyze

> InnooRyze is a Growth Systems, MarTech and AI consulting and product company that designs and builds customer experiences, connected customer technology, AI agents and digital products.

InnooRyze works with businesses across the US, UK, APAC and India, including Singapore, Japan and Malaysia. Company address: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Contact: enquiry@innooryze.com.

## Growth Systems

- [Growth Systems: CX, MarTech & Data Consulting](https://innooryze.com/growth-systems): Customer experience design, CRM and MarTech implementation, and customer data activation, connected in one growth system.
- [Customer Experience Design & Enablement](https://innooryze.com/growth-systems/experience-design-enablement): Design and build connected customer experiences, websites, portals, business applications and custom SaaS around the people who use them.
- [MarTech, CRM & Marketing Automation Consulting](https://innooryze.com/growth-systems/martech-consulting-enablement): Assess, architect, implement and integrate the CRM, marketing automation and MarTech platforms behind customer engagement.
- [Customer Data, CDP & Data Activation Consulting](https://innooryze.com/growth-systems/data-intelligence-activation): Unify, understand and activate customer data through CDP strategy, segmentation, audience activation, analytics and measurement.

## AI Agents & Automation

- [AI Agent Development & Automation Consulting](https://innooryze.com/ai-agents): Custom AI agent development and AI automation consulting: agents for business that connect to your knowledge, CRM, APIs and workflows.

## Products

- [AI Products & Custom SaaS Development](https://innooryze.com/products): LeadRyze AI, LeadRyze CRM, IMMA and the custom SaaS, business applications and AI-enabled products InnooRyze designs and builds for clients.
- [LeadRyze AI — Intelligent AI Lead Desk](https://innooryze.com/products/leadryze-ai): LeadRyze AI answers buyers, qualifies enquiries, captures leads, helps book meetings and connects with CRM.
- [IMMA — Marketing Maturity Assessment](https://innooryze.com/products/imma): IMMA is a live marketing maturity assessment from InnooRyze. Get an overall score, maturity level, category-wise results, recommendations and a roadmap.
- [LeadRyze CRM](https://innooryze.com/products#leadryze-crm): Built by InnooRyze. LeadRyze CRM is an InnooRyze-built CRM designed to help growing businesses organise customer and lead information and support structured sales follow-up. It is a separate product from LeadRyze AI, our AI lead desk.

## Client work and case studies

- [Client Work & Case Studies](https://innooryze.com/work): Client work and case studies from InnooRyze across customer experience, CRM and MarTech, with clear context and outcomes we can substantiate.
- [Dynalektric — Industrial Website & RFQ Journey](https://innooryze.com/work/dynalektric): Website strategy, UX, design, development and SEO improvement for an industrial electrical manufacturer, with a product architecture and RFQ enquiry journey.
- [Qualtura — Website Experience & Zoho Integration](https://innooryze.com/work/qualtura): Website experience, design and responsive development across approximately six pages, with the enquiry journey connected to Zoho.
- [Treffer Technologies — CRM & MarTech Enablement](https://innooryze.com/work/treffer-technologies): CRM strategy, MarTech strategy and enablement, shaping a connected operating direction for customer engagement.
- [US Industrial Valve Digital Experience](https://innooryze.com/work/industrial-valve-digital-experience): A clearer, more credible digital experience for a specialist industrial valve portfolio, built around technical buyers and the applications the products serve.
- [Building IMMA — Marketing Maturity Assessment](https://innooryze.com/work/imma): How InnooRyze designed and built IMMA, a live marketing maturity assessment, from verified sign-in and structured questions to scores, recommendations and a roadmap.

## Ideas Hub

- [Ideas Hub — Experience, MarTech, Data & AI](https://innooryze.com/ideas-hub): Perspectives, articles and guides on customer experience, marketing technology, data intelligence and practical AI.
- [Choosing the right CDP for your growth stage.](https://innooryze.com/ideas-hub/choosing-the-right-cdp-for-your-growth-stage): Start with the decisions and customer experiences you need to improve. Then choose the data foundation to support them.
- [Why AI needs human-centered strategy.](https://innooryze.com/ideas-hub/why-ai-needs-human-centered-strategy): Useful AI starts with an understanding of people, their context and the work that needs to get done.
- [3 common mistakes in MarTech implementation.](https://innooryze.com/ideas-hub/3-common-mistakes-in-martech-implementation): The platform is only part of the work. Alignment, data and adoption determine whether the system becomes useful.
